query:
SELECT 
  po.id,
  po.purchaseOrderNumber,
  po.partnerId,
  p.name as partnerName,
  po.totalAmount,
  po.status,
  po.createdAt,
  po.notes
FROM purchaseOrders po
LEFT JOIN partners p ON po.partnerId = p.id
WHERE po.purchaseOrderNumber = '780001';
